description: Measure block production time statistics over last 100 blocks (원본 stress/block-time.sh) The average interval must sit at the configured period, not merely under a minute: every preset this runs on is configured for one block per second (blockPeriodSeconds 1 in the stablenet and wbft genesis), so the average must be at most 2 seconds. There is no lower bound because go-wemix, as chainbench composes it, averaged 0.79-0.86s — some blocks share a timestamp second — measured both right after start and after block 90 (2026-09-29). A lower bound of 1 would fail wemix on a behaviour this case does not own.
